In plain English

Operator CPC is the qualification associated with being a transport manager on a goods-vehicle operator licence. It is not Driver CPC, and it is not a driving entitlement. This page is an example course. It does not state an exam date, a fee or a pass mark.

Who it is for

People who need the transport-manager qualification, or who want to understand what it covers before they book. It is not periodic driver training.

What it covers

  • Preparation for the transport-manager exams, in the form the course actually covers
  • Not a Driver Qualification Card, and not a Category C or C+E licence

The examining body and the current exam format should be checked against official guidance. This example page does not set either.

Eligibility and prerequisites

General guidance, not a check of your licence.

  • No driving entitlement is assumed
  • The difference between Operator CPC and Driver CPC is explained before anyone books
  • This page does not confirm that a person needs the qualification for their licence

What the training includes

  • How Operator CPC differs from Driver CPC
  • What the study covers, in outline
  • How to ask about dates
  • The example bases that list the course

How the course works

  1. Enquire about Operator CPC

    Say that you mean the transport-manager qualification, not Driver CPC.

  2. Confirm the exams you are aiming for

    The current format is checked against official guidance. It is not stated as a pass mark here.

  3. Study for the qualification

    Classroom preparation. No timetable is published on this example page.

  4. Ask how the exam is booked

    Booking is explained when you enquire. This site does not claim a result.

Why train here

  • The course, stated plainly

    Who it is for, what it leads to, and how the training runs, before anyone is asked to commit.

  • Courses matched to a base

    Each course lists the example bases that run it. A base does not advertise training it does not offer.

  • Practical and classroom routes

    Licence training is time in the vehicle. Driver CPC, ADR and Operator CPC are set out as their own courses.

  • A straight enquiry

    The form asks for a course, a preferred base and how you would like to be contacted. It does not book a test.

Questions about this course

Is Operator CPC the same as Driver CPC?

No. Operator CPC is the transport-manager qualification. Driver CPC is for professional drivers. They are separate courses.
